traditionalDress.men: A kediyu (a frock-style, frilled kurta) worn over a chorno (loose cotton trousers resembling a stitched dhoti), often with a colorful turban called a phento.
traditionalDress.women: A chaniya choli (or ghagra choli) — a flared, mirror-worked skirt with a fitted blouse and a dupatta — worn especially for Garba and Dandiya Raas during Navratri.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.description: Nine nights of worship of the Mother Goddess, marked by the Garba and Dandiya Raas folk dances performed in large circles around a central lamp or shrine.

festivals.name: Uttarayan
festivals.description: Gujarat's kite festival, held around mid-January, when rooftops across the state fill with people flying and competing with colorful kites.

festivals.name: Rann Utsav
festivals.description: A winter cultural festival held on the white salt desert of the Great Rann of Kutch, featuring local music, dance, handicrafts, and moonlit camping.

folklore: The legend of Jesal and Toral, set in the Kutch region, tells of a bandit named Jesal who is transformed by Toral, a devout woman, after he tries to steal a prized mare from her stable; she guides him away from his violent life toward devotion, and both are venerated today at a shrine in Anjar.
